title: Charge-Skip Protocol + Delayed-Receipt Reconciliation for At-Least-Once Ingest
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: We continue to see customer-facing sporadic double charges tied to transient network failures and client retries across the hosted API. Current retry mitigation solutions (opaque tokens, strict leases, and watermarks) reduce but do not eliminate edge-caused duplicate accounting when clients disconnect mid-request or when edge proxies replay requests with stale cookies. We need a solution that: (1) prevents visible duplicate billing at customer scale, (2) preserves availability (low latency, no extra round trips on the hot path), and (3) requires minimal client migration and server state retention.

Proposal (Charge-Skip Protocol with Delayed-Receipt Reconciliation):
- Client-side: Clients generate a stable per-call CommitNonce (monotonic per connection or per logical session) and include a compact SDK-signed header (CSP-Commit: base64(CommitNonce|client-id|sig)). This allows stateless server detection of obvious replays without a heavy UUID handshake.
- Ingest fast-path (no extra round trips): The serving edge accepts the request and emits a provisional charge token (ProvisionalReceipt) immediately in response headers and body. This provisional receipt is only a short-lived promise of a charge and is tagged as 'provisional' in billing views.
- Short-term crediting behavior: Downstream billing is deferred for a small window (configurable, default 60s). During the window, if a matching finalization call arrives (CSP-Finalize with CommitNonce), the ProvisionalReceipt is upgraded to FinalReceipt and billed once. If no finalize arrives within the window, the system performs a probabilistic reconciliation pass to decide whether to convert the provisional to a final charge or to skip charging entirely.
- Probabilistic reconciliation: Use a combination of cheap content-sketch similarity (MinHash over prompt/first-k-tokens) + service-side heuristics (client activity, connection logs) to compute a confidence score that another ingest already consumed the logical request. At high confidence we mark the provisional as skipped and emit a compensating bookkeeping event; at medium confidence we surface to ops for manual review thresholds and to ML-based replay detector for future training.
- Durable audit trail: All provisional receipts, finalizations, and reconciliation decisions are recorded in the ledger with causal anchors (timestamp, commitNonce, edge-id) to allow later forensic queries and refunds.

Why this is different: Existing patterns in the codebase focus on pessimistic locking (leases) or absolute once semantics at ingest time, which adds latency or requires global coordination. CSP favors availability by making the hot path optimistic and resolving duplicates asynchronously with a small window. It reduces client churn by avoiding an extra finalize round trip as a requirement and instead treats finalization as an accelerator for certainty.

Trade-offs and risks:
- Small time window where charges are provisional creates UX complexity for customers expecting immediate final billing. We must surface provisional vs final billing clearly in dashboards and invoices.
- Probabilistic reconciliation can occasionally result in false-skips or late charges. We mitigate by conservative thresholds and a customer-visible audit log with clear dispute/reconciliation paths.
- Storage/retention: We need to store provisional receipts for window + reconciliation metadata. Estimate additional storage ~20% of current ledger write volume for first 90 days.
- Edge clients that don't use CommitNonce will degrade to a TTL-based deconfliction path (coarser), requiring SDK upgrades for best behavior.

Implementation plan (phased):
1) Design + API (2 weeks): Finalize header shapes, provisional receipt format, and dashboard UI copy. Wireframe invoice language. (Owner: PM)
2) Edge runtime (3 sprints): Implement CSP-Commit header parsing, provisional receipt emission, and local short-term cache of recent commitNonces with LRU eviction. Emit provisional ledger writes to a dedicated provisional-shard. (Owner: Edge team)
3) Billing pipeline (2 sprints): Add provisional->final state machine, reconciliation microservice that runs periodic passes, and compensating event pipeline for skipped charges. Add metrics: provisional_count, upgraded_count, skipped_count, reconciliation_latency. (Owner: Billing team)
4) Reconciliation ML/heuristics (3 sprints parallel): Implement MinHash sketch generation at ingest, initial heuristics, and dataset collection for ML-based replay detector. (Owner: Applied ML)
5) Console & docs (2 sprints): Billing UI flags, provisional receipts table, and dispute playbook in Support docs. (Owner: Console + Docs)
6) Canary rollout (4 weeks): Route 5% of traffic to CSP for non-critical customers; monitor false-skip rate and customer support volume. Gradually increase.

SLOs & success metrics:
- Reduce visible duplicate billing incidents by >= 95% for canary cohort.
- Reconciliation decision latency < 120s (95th percentile).
- False-skip rate < 0.05% on canary.
- No degradation in median latency on hot path (<2% change).

Observability & dashboards:
- New per-customer provisional vs final charge timeseries.
- Reconciliation confidence histogram.
- Top 10 customers with highest provisional churn.
- Postmortem traces: link provisional receipts to serving traces and to proxy logs for forensic analysis.

Rollout concerns & mitigation:
- Legal/invoice: Coordinate with Finance to label provisional invoice items and postpone final invoice creation until finalization or end-of-billing-window. (Action item: Finance review)
- SDK adoption: Provide server-side fallback now, but ship SDKs that auto-generate CommitNonce for maximum benefit. Track adoption via header percentage.
- Chargeback process: Build a self-serve refund pipeline for false-charges discovered during reconciliation.

Open questions:
- Default provisional window: 30s, 60s, or 120s? Recommendation: 60s to balance latency and reconciliation accuracy.
- How to handle multi-step requests (streaming tokens + final response)? Proposal: issue provisional on first successful token generation and attach stream context to allow upgrade.
- Per-customer opt-out or strict-on options for enterprise contracts? Yes: enterprise tenants can opt into strict-lease mode.

Compliance/security notes: The provisional receipt contains a signed digest and minimal PII (client-id). All receipts must be stored encrypted at rest. Security review required prior to GA.
